(() => {if(document.querySelector('.map-panel [data-trace]'))throw Error('Generic plotter still present');if(document.querySelector('#field-systolic').value!=='120'||document.querySelector('#field-diastolic').value!=='80')throw Error('Default shared pressures');window.__mapBase=Number(document.querySelector('[data-map-group=slider1]').getAttribute('transform').match(/-?[0-9.]+/g).at(-1));return 'Unique bridge with shared 120/80 inputs';})()

(() => {if(document.querySelector('[data-anatomy-result]').textContent!=='103,3'||document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='103,3'||document.querySelector('#field-systolic').value!=='150')throw Error('Systolic influence or synchronization');window.__mapS=Number(document.querySelector('[data-map-group=slider1]').getAttribute('transform').match(/-?[0-9.]+/g).at(-1))-window.__mapBase;if(window.__mapS>=0)throw Error('Readout did not rise');return 'Systolic +30: both results +10 and physical readout rises';})()

(() => {if(document.querySelector('[data-anatomy-result]').textContent!=='113,3'||document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='113,3')throw Error('Diastolic influence');const d=Number(document.querySelector('[data-map-group=slider1]').getAttribute('transform').match(/-?[0-9.]+/g).at(-1))-window.__mapBase;if(Math.abs(d/window.__mapS-2)>.0001)throw Error('Physical 1:2 weighting');return 'Diastolic +30: both results +20 and readout moves twice as far';})()

(() => {if(Number(document.querySelector('#field-systolic').value)<=120)throw Error('Direct endpoint drag');if(document.querySelector('#anatomy-systolic').value!==document.querySelector('#field-systolic').value)throw Error('Dragged values diverged');return 'Both endpoint keyboard and drag interaction update shared inputs';})()
